audit_items.proof_trace: The property holds. `unsafe_repay_debt_only` computes `residual = if ceil(debt) <= coin.value() { coin.value() - ceil(debt) } else { 0 }` (i.e., min-repay and max-refund), then `handle_repay` materialises the refund via `coin.split(residual, ctx)` and deposits the remainder into the reserve — exactly matching the debt reduction in both cases. Use of `ceil()` on debt is intentional rounding for decimal precision and does not violate the invariant.
